status: Descriptive fixed-source audit; not independent metric validation
method: Same original bundle cameras, native annotations remapped to undistorted raster, nearest positive-Z point at each rounded pixel, no dilation or increased splat footprint. Frozen boundaries excluded. All points, not viewer subsamples.
limits: Point occupancy can be background behind a missing plant part.
Three P4 landmarks share camera model, poses and scale with reconstruction.
Landmark intervals contain pixel annotation perturbation only, not camera or scale uncertainty.
Nearest-neighbour distance describes agreement and is not an accuracy score.
All source samples are localized assistant-reviewed annotations, not full-plant masks.
